groups.name: Single font family, no web fonts
groups.definition: Does the page use only one font family (typically a system font stack) for all text with no web fonts loaded?

groups.name: Serif body paired with sans headings
groups.definition: Is a serif face used for body or descriptive text while headings, nav and UI use a sans-serif?

groups.name: Serif display headings with sans body
groups.definition: Are headings set in a serif display face while body and UI text use a sans-serif?

groups.name: Heavy condensed display face for headings
groups.definition: Does the page pair a body sans with a heavy condensed display typeface for headings?

groups.name: Three-face type system with script accents
groups.definition: Does the page combine a sans body, a serif heading face and a handwritten script accent face?

groups.name: Generous body line height
groups.definition: Is body text set with a line height of roughly 1.5 or more of the font size?

groups.name: Uppercase tracked eyebrow label above heading
groups.definition: Does a small uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow or kicker label sit above section headings or the main headline?

groups.name: Small uppercase letter-spaced labels
groups.definition: Are small uppercase letter-spaced labels used for categories, metadata, stats, or list/group headings?

groups.name: Uppercase tracked nav and button labels
groups.definition: Are navigation, button, badge or footer labels set in uppercase with letter-spacing?

groups.name: All-caps large section headings
groups.definition: Are headings set in large all-caps type?

groups.name: Sentence-case titles contrasting all-caps labels
groups.definition: Do card or article titles use sentence case in contrast with all-caps labels or headings?

groups.name: Large bold H1 with defined heading scale
groups.definition: Is the h1 large and bold with a clearly smaller bold h2 forming a distinct heading scale?

groups.name: Extreme type scale contrast
groups.definition: Is there extreme contrast between huge display headings and small body text with few intermediate sizes?

groups.name: Headings at body size
groups.definition: Are section headings set at body size or only modestly larger so hierarchy is weak?

groups.name: Two-color split heading
groups.definition: Is a heading split into two colors or weights within one headline, such as an accent-colored line or word?

groups.name: Light or regular-weight large headings
groups.definition: Are large headings set in light or regular weight rather than bold?

groups.name: White hero headline on dark or photo
groups.definition: Is the hero headline large white type over a dark, colored or photo background?

groups.name: Italic serif tagline or secondary text
groups.definition: Is italic text used for taglines, secondary links or disclaimers?

groups.name: Lead paragraph then smaller body
groups.definition: Does intro text use a larger lighter lead paragraph followed by smaller darker body text?

groups.name: Underlined inline links
groups.definition: Are inline links within paragraphs underlined?

groups.name: Bold labels with little prose
groups.definition: Is bold text used heavily for names and labels with little paragraph prose?

groups.name: Navy-colored headings
groups.definition: Are headings colored dark navy rather than black?

groups.name: Meta text such as bylines is very small, gray sans with a mi
groups.definition: Meta text such as bylines is very small, gray sans with a middle-dot separator.
